questiontext.text:
(a) A car drives for {@if questionType="time" then sconcat("\\(", float(distA), "km\\)") else sconcat("\\(", float(timeA), "hrs\\)")@} at an average speed of {@if integerp(speedA) then speedA else float(speedA)@}\(m/s\).

Find the {@if questionType="time" then "time taken for this journey in hours." else "distance of this journey in kilometres."@}

[[input:ans1]] {@if questionType="time" then "\\(hrs\\)" else "\\(km\\)"@} [[validation:ans1]]

(2)

[[feedback:prt1]]

(b) A snail travels \({@if integerp(distBdisp) then distBdisp else float(distBdisp)@}{@distBunits@}\) between \({@timeHour@}:{@timeStart@}\) and \({@timeHour+1@}:{@if timeEnd<10 then sconcat("0",timeEnd) else timeEnd@}\).

Find the average speed of the snail in \(km/h\).

[[input:ans2]] \(km/h\) [[validation:ans2]]

(2)

[[feedback:prt2]]

questionnote.text:
(a) Find the {@questionType@}. Speed: {@speedA@}, Time: {@timeA@}

(a) Distance: {@distBdisp@}\({@distBunits@}\), Time: {@timeB@}

truefeedback.text:
Here is a worked solution:

To convert \(m/s\) into \(km/h\), multiply by \(3600\) (seconds in an hour) and divide by \(1000\) (metres in a kilometre).

This is equivalent to multiplying by \(\frac{18}{5}\) or \(3.6\)


\({@float(speedA)@} m/s \ \ (\times \frac{18}{5}) = {@float(speedA*18/5)@} km/h\)

\(T = \frac{D}{S}\)

\(\Rightarrow T = \frac{{@float(distA)@}}{{@float(speedA*18/5)@}}\)

\(\Rightarrow T = {@float(timeA)@}hrs\)
